slots.DEFINITION: A class of pharmaceutical agents that competitively inhibit beta-adrenergic receptors to reduce heart rate, lower myocardial contractility, and decrease blood pressure.
slots.MECHANISM: Competitively antagonizes beta-1 adrenergic receptors in cardiac tissue (SA node & myocardium), decreasing cAMP production, calcium influx, and sinoatrial firing rate.
slots.MISCONCEPTIONS: Myth: 'Beta-blockers can be abruptly stopped once blood pressure is normal.' Fact: Abrupt cessation triggers dangerous rebound tachycardia, severe hypertension, and acute myocardial ischemia due to beta-receptor upregulation.
slots.RISKS_SAFETY: Absolute Contraindications: Severe sinus bradycardia (<50 bpm), cardiogenic shock, second/third-degree AV block, and decompensated heart failure. Caution in Asthma/COPD due to bronchospasm from beta-2 blockade.
slots.APPLICATIONS: Secondary prevention post-myocardial infarction, heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), systemic hypertension, and rate control in atrial fibrillation.

slots.DEFINITION: Medications that inhibit Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme to prevent conversion of Angiotensin I to Angiotensin II.
slots.MECHANISM: Decreases systemic vascular resistance via arterial vasodilation and lowers aldosterone secretion, reducing renal sodium and water retention.
slots.RISKS_SAFETY: Adverse effects: Persistent dry cough (bradykinin accumulation), hyperkalemia, and rare life-threatening angioedema. Absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy.
slots.APPLICATIONS: First-line pharmacotherapy for hypertension, diabetic nephropathy, and heart failure.

slots.DEFINITION: A 3,000 PSI triple-redundant fluid power transmission system consisting of System A, System B, and Standby System.
slots.MECHANISM: Engine-Driven Pumps (EDPs) and AC Electric Motor-Driven Pumps (EMDPs) circulate Skydrol fluid at 3,000 PSI to actuate primary flight controls, flaps, landing gear, and thrust reversers.
slots.MISCONCEPTIONS: Myth: 'Total hydraulic loss renders flight controls impossible to move.' Fact: Manual Reversion mode uses mechanical steel cables connected directly to elevator and aileron tabs with increased pilot control force.
slots.RISKS_SAFETY: Dual System A and B failure activates Standby System specifically for the rudder and leading edge devices. Landing distance increases by up to 70% in manual reversion.

slots.DEFINITION: A dual-rotor, high-bypass ratio turbofan engine producing 19,500 to 27,300 lbf of takeoff thrust.
slots.MECHANISM: Single-stage fan and 3-stage LP booster driven by a 4-stage LP turbine; 9-stage HP compressor driven by a single-stage HP turbine with dual-channel FADEC control.
slots.PROPERTIES: Bypass ratio: 5.1 to 5.5; Overall pressure ratio: 32.7; Fan diameter: 61 inches.

python_mastery.name: Python Programming
python_mastery.domain: Computer Science, CPython VM & Software Architecture

slots.DEFINITION: The underlying C runtime architecture and memory management subsystem of CPython, comprising PyObject headers, PyMalloc allocators, and dual-engine memory reclamation (refcounting + cyclic GC).
slots.MECHANISM: PyMalloc allocates memory in 256KB Arenas, 4KB Pools, and 8-to-512 byte quantized Blocks. Python uses immediate reference counting (ob_refcnt) supplemented by a 3-generation cyclic garbage collector for double-linked circular references.
slots.MISCONCEPTIONS: Myth: 'del x deletes the object from memory.' Fact: 'del x' only unbinds the variable name and decrements ob_refcnt by 1. The object is only deallocated when refcount reaches 0. Myth: 'The GIL prevents application race conditions.' Fact: The GIL only protects CPython's internal C state; user threads still require threading.Lock().
slots.PROPERTIES: Small integer caching: [-5, 256] pre-allocated. Arena size: 256 KB. GC Generation 0 threshold: 700 allocations.

slots.DEFINITION: Foundational Python syntax, arbitrary-precision integer representations, and hardware Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) bitwise operations (&, |, ^, ~, <<, >>).
slots.MECHANISM: Two's complement emulation: Python treats negative integers as infinite leading 1s, meaning ~x == (-x) - 1 (~0 == -1, ~5 == -6). 1-bit full adder logic: Sum = A ^ B ^ Cin; Cout = (A & B) | (Cin & (A ^ B)).
slots.MISCONCEPTIONS: Myth: 'is and == are interchangeable.' Fact: 'is' checks memory pointer identity; '==' checks value equality.
slots.APPLICATIONS: Embedded MicroPython GPIO control, high-speed cryptographic permutations, binary packet decoding (struct), and hardware logic emulation.

slots.DEFINITION: Object-oriented design and runtime metaprogramming structures in Python.
slots.MECHANISM: Method Resolution Order (MRO) is computed via C3 Superpermutation Linearization. Descriptors intercept attribute access via __get__, __set__, and __delete__ protocol methods.
slots.APPLICATIONS: Custom ORMs, validation frameworks (Pydantic), property decorators, and dynamic class synthesis.

music_mastery.name: Universal Music Theory
music_mastery.domain: Acoustic Physics, Indian Classical & Global Music Systems

slots.DEFINITION: Ancient microtonal modal music traditions of the Indian subcontinent rooted in the Natya Shastra and Sangeeta Ratnakara.
slots.MECHANISM: Built on 22 Shrutis (microtonal intervals), 7 basic Swaras (Sa, Ri, Ga, Ma, Pa, Dha, Ni), 72 parent Melakarta ragas (Carnatic) / 10 Thaats (Hindustani), and 35 Talas (cyclic rhythmic frameworks) with continuous Gamaka oscillations.
slots.MISCONCEPTIONS: Myth: 'Ragas are just Western scales.' Fact: A raga is a dynamic living melodic framework with specific ascending/descending rules (Arohana/Avarohana), characteristic phrases (Pakar/Chalan), and temporal mood associations (Rasa/Prahar).
slots.PROPERTIES: 22 Shrutis derived via Sa-Pa (3:2 fifths) and Sa-Ma (4:3 fourths) Pythagorean cycles. 72 Melakarta system organized into 12 Chakras of 6 ragas each.

slots.DEFINITION: Tonal harmonic systems based on equal temperament (12-TET), diatonic major/minor scales, functional chord progressions, and species counterpoint.
slots.MECHANISM: Chords built in stacked thirds (triads and 7ths) with functional tension-resolution cycles (Tonic I -> Subdominant IV -> Dominant V7 -> Tonic I). Strict voice leading avoids parallel 5ths and 8ths to maintain voice independence.
slots.APPLICATIONS: Orchestral composition, jazz harmony (tritone substitutions, chord extensions), film scoring, and modern audio engineering.

slots.DEFINITION: The physical science of sound propagation, harmonic series, and digital signal processing (DSP) in Digital Audio Workstations.
slots.MECHANISM: Harmonic series follows integer multiples of the fundamental frequency (f, 2f, 3f, 4f...). Equal temperament frequency formula: f_n = f_0 * 2^(n/12). Nyquist-Shannon theorem requires sample rate >= 2 * highest frequency (44.1 kHz for 20 kHz human hearing).
slots.PROPERTIES: Speed of sound in dry air at 20C: 343 m/s. Dynamic range of 24-bit audio: ~144 dB.

slots.DEFINITION: An organic vessel produced by female avian species to nourish and protect a developing embryo, serving as a complete biological protein benchmark.
slots.COMPONENTS: Shell (95% calcium carbonate CaCO3 with 17,000 respiratory pores), Albumen (Ovalbumin, Ovotransferrin, Lysozyme), Yolk (lipids, vitellin, lecithin, cholesterol), Chalazae (protein cords centering the yolk).
slots.PROPERTIES: Average mass: 50g; Protein density: 12.6% by weight (exactly 6.3g protein per standard 50g egg); Coagulation temp: 60C to 65C.
slots.MECHANISM: Thermal denaturation: Heating above 60C breaks hydrogen bonds, unfolding globular protein chains which cross-link into an irreversible hydrophobic hydrogel mesh.
slots.MISCONCEPTIONS: Myth: 'Brown eggs are healthier and more nutritious than white eggs.' Fact: Shell color is determined strictly by hen breed genetics (e.g. Leghorn vs Rhode Island Red); nutritional value is identical.
